underlying_pin_evidence: vlc-3.0.24/contrib/src/taglib/rules.mak sets TAGLIB_VERSION 1.13.1; the archive's SHA-512 equals vlc-3.0.24/contrib/src/taglib/SHA512SUMS, checked in the Dockerfile
coverage: LLVM source coverage in VLC's statically registered tagged-MP3 plugins (skiptags stream filter, es demuxer with VLC's own ID3v2 reader in meta_engine/ID3Tag.h, ID3Meta.h and ID3Text.h, mpegaudio packetizer, taglib meta reader) and in the pinned, VLC-patched TagLib 1.13.1 it links, built from source with static libvlccore and libVLC and called through libvlc_media_parse_with_options on a local file from a C byte-input harness
parser_family: VLC 3.0.24 tagged-MP3 path. The skiptags stream filter strips the leading ID3v2 tag; the es demuxer probes MPEG audio, parses the stored tag with VLC's own ID3v2 reader and loads the mpegaudio packetizer for the track. es reports unsupported meta, so src/input/input.c also runs the highest-priority meta reader, VLC's TagLib plugin, which reparses the raw file with TagLib and whose values are merged last. libvlccore is built without dynamic plugins and the harness registers only filesystem, skiptags, es, packetizer_mpegaudio and taglib through vlc_static_modules. TagLib is shared with the separate C TagLib path, which uses TagLib 2.3.2; this path uses VLC's pinned 1.13.1 with VLC's patches. The C++ call site uses the same libVLC API
